description: Windows 10 / 11 client SYN, window 64240 (44 x MSS 1460; FoxIO lists it for Windows 11), MSS 1460

provenance.notes: SYN traits attested by real traffic in the Zardaxt public database (profiles/reference/tcp_public.json): window 64240 is sent by 30% of Windows sessions (28% of canonical ones), the second most common value after 65535; FoxIO publishes JA4T=64240_2-1-3-1-1-4_1460_8 as its Windows 11 example. Every other trait and every unverified part is the same as windows_65535 (see its notes).
